The rest of the site states scientific claims inline, in running prose, on the
page that needs them. This page instead collects every claim registered in the
governed [claim registry](../data/trust/claim_registry.json) in one readable
ledger: what it says in plain language, what it says formally, which evidence
rung it currently occupies, what would falsify it, which critiques target it
and their disposition, and which pages make the claim. It replaces reading the
raw registry JSON to answer "what does AffineDrift actually claim, and how
solid is it?"

::: {.callout-warning title="Scientific Authority Boundary"}
Presentation cannot promote a claim or infer human, coaching, clinical,
equipment, design, causal, or population authority. A claim's evidence rung
describes what its declared model and evidence class currently support — not
that the claim is true of any golfer, population, or real-world outcome.
:::

## How to Read a Claim Card

Each card below carries a human-readable anchor (for example `#claim-ad-dcr-001`)
so it can be linked to directly. The **plain-language statement** is a
non-amplifying summary; the **formal statement** is the exact governed claim
text and its modal strength (`hypothesis`, `bounded`, `supported`, or
`established`); the **evidence rung** is the same tier ladder used across the
site's [evidence presentation summary](../models/research-protocol-readiness.html);
**falsifiers** are the declared conditions that would refute or materially
narrow the claim; **critiques** lists every entry in the
[critique ledger](../critiques/index.html) whose `related_claim_ids` names this
claim, with its current disposition; and **pages making this claim** lists
every page that authors or cites it.

{{< include ../_includes/generated/claims-ledger.qmd >}}

## Add or Revise a Claim

Claims are governed data, not prose. Add or revise an entry in
[`data/trust/claim_registry.json`](../data/trust/claim_registry.json) against
its [strict schema](../schemas/trust-metadata-v1.schema.json), link any
critique that concerns it in
[`data/trust/claim_critique_ledger.json`](../data/trust/claim_critique_ledger.json),
then regenerate this page and its per-page links:

```powershell
python -m scripts.generate_claims_ledger
python -m scripts.generate_claims_ledger --check
python -m pytest tests/test_claims_ledger.py
```
